records.current_pi_or_kb: Gary confirmed pi-mind harness repo; KB/archive remain separate.
records.draft: Stage in KB only for review; pi-mind canonical copy and common installer are future work.

records.design: Authenticated writer, server-enforced identity, owner review credentials.
records.current_pi_or_kb: W1 server instructions explicitly say configured writer with no authentication or authority-changing review tools; writer_assurance=configured.
records.draft: Keep exact W1 assurance enum; joined dispatch context is server-bound, and authentication/owner-only review requires service tests.

records.current_pi_or_kb: W1 MemoryRecord supports lesson/stale_flag/feedback only, with no separate authority field.
records.draft: Preserve W1. Proposed annotation-record has new kinds, authority=annotation, new payload schemas; shared-memory-record unions both.

records.design: Supporting stable evidence identities, exact source revision and locator, reviewable support.
records.current_pi_or_kb: W1 references are unchecked memory/file/commit/url/session values; lesson support is always not found.
records.draft: Preserve W1. New source-evidence-reference and contribution-evidence-reference add source spans for new annotations; verified lesson support remains a future version/service gate.

records.design: Annotations and flags can target exact source revisions.
records.current_pi_or_kb: W1 target-reference schema permits source, but service.target rejects it until catalog IDs exist.
records.draft: Schema acceptance is not a current capability; source target dispatch waits for P2/P4.

records.design: Recorded recheck closes technical flags; Gary closes authoritative guidance flags.
records.current_pi_or_kb: W1 stale-flag payload resolution/resolved_at are null and all flags stay open.
records.draft: New mind/stale-flag@2 branch in annotation-record permits recorded closure; paired fields are validated. W1 remains open-only.
Keep W1 fields, propose optional history/cursor; reject simultaneous cursor and offset. Retired/expired history behavior requires an adapter and service tests.

records.design: Read by record ID/revision/history or receipt key during recovery.
records.current_pi_or_kb: W1 accepts optional id,revision,history,request_key and scopes, including an empty argument object structurally.
records.draft: Keep every field; joined contract requires id or request_key. Define response records/receipt envelope explicitly rather than implying W1 emits it.

records.current_pi_or_kb: W1 accepts only an empty object and returns database/scope/projection state.
records.draft: Proposed component enum and joined response schema; W1 remains empty-input until an explicit adapter is implemented.

records.design: Joined structured responses carry source/index/graph snapshot, privacy, availability, pagination and errors.
records.current_pi_or_kb: W1 pi-mind/memory-response@1 uses backend_availability object and record-specific fields with no source snapshots.
records.draft: Propose mind-tool-response/v1 metadata plus data; preserve raw W1 record/write-receipt schemas and adapt read envelopes explicitly.

records.design: Illustration uses omitted_source_spans, graph_snapshot string unavailable, Markdown locator start/end.
records.current_pi_or_kb: W1 receipts use omitted_count; pi selectors use explicit start_offset/end_offset.
records.draft: Propose omitted_count, null absent snapshots, start_line/end_line for Markdown. These differences are presented for approval; _meta.mind is a metadata record beside legacy payload.

records.design: Keep existing string/list/dict payloads and provenance for every returned span.
records.current_pi_or_kb: Existing KB payloads have no source-version/locator sidecars.
records.draft: Draft schemas preserve opaque legacy payload objects and top-level types. Metadata is separately validated; per-hit locator correspondence, clipping and byte equality require nonempty gateway integration tests.

records.design: New requests and writes return structured receipts and allow one classified temporary same-key replay, receipt lookup first.
records.current_pi_or_kb: W1 write tools return the raw pi-mind receipt; there are no joined schemas/context envelopes.
records.draft: Reuse receipt byte-for-byte inside a joined receipt+metadata response; one replay is service policy, not implied by a JSON boolean. No new source writes are authorized.
